items.note: Well grounded; captures the 80/20 split accurately, though loses the specific percentages.

items.gold_modify_target: The agent's learning curve is front-loaded; initial expertise comes from training data and sold listings, but transaction experience is needed to learn niche-specific details.
items.gold_modification: Split more precisely into ~80% data-driven expertise (the agent's edge, sufficient for positive expected value) and ~20% tacit knowledge gap (the ceiling and rationale for human-in-the-loop).
items.note: Production carries the prior item almost verbatim ('The agent's learning curve is front-loaded, with initial expertise from data and subsequent expertise from transaction experience') without incorporating the 80/20 split refinement. A separate new agreement captures the 80/20 distinction but the prior item itself is not modified.

items.gold_carryover_item: The viable model is human-in-the-loop: agent handles knowledge work, user makes judgment calls on edge cases, with agent knowledge compounding over time.
items.note: Production has 'The viable model is human-in-the-loop: agent handles knowledge work, user makes judgment calls on edge cases (established earlier).' The 'compounding over time' nuance is dropped.

items.gold_carryover_item: The gating test for the business is whether an agent can build genuine market expertise in a tech niche; 70-80% expertise from data alone may be sufficient for positive expected value per trade.

judgement.overall_note: Production correctly adds the 'information asymmetry' framing and the 80/20 tacit-knowledge distinction as new agreements, and the new decision about human-in-the-loop as the primary viability path is grounded. However, it misses three of four gold-required additions: the explicit cold-start + community-friction risk reframing, the specific next-step recommendation (pick one tech submarket), and the consolidated 'High viability' verdict. The one required modification (refining the learning-curve item to embed the 80/20 split) was not executed. Carryover items are preserved but with several key qualifiers silently dropped ('compounding over time,' 'relationship poisoning,' 'if that fails, there is no business').
